description.zh:
是否扩散统计类消息，打开时在加入消息组后会广播消息组的统计信息，客户端可以接收处理该消息。取值：

- true：扩散统计类消息。

- false：不扩散统计类消息。
description.en:
Specifies whether to broadcast statistics messages. When enabled, statistics information of the message group will be broadcast after joining the message group, and the client can receive and process this message. Valid values:

- true: Broadcast statistics messages.
- false: Do not broadcast statistics messages.

description.zh:
系统消息扩散类型，取值：

- 0（默认值）：不扩散。

- 1：扩散到指定人。

- 2：扩散到群组。
description.en:
System message diffusion type. Valid values:

- 0 (default): No diffusion.
- 1: Diffusion to specified users.
- 2: Diffusion to the group.

description.zh: 要加入的消息组ID，请确保传入的GroupId是存在的。
description.en: The ID of the message group to join. Make sure the GroupId you provide exists.

description.zh: 用户UserId，用户自定义，在AppId下单独唯一。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度32个字符。不同的用户需要使用不同的UserId。
description.en: User ID, which is customized by the user and must be unique under the AppId. It can contain lowercase letters, numbers, underscores (\_), and periods (.). The maximum length is 32 characters. Different users must use different UserIds.

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为200次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: The QPS limit for this API is 200 calls per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Please use this API responsibly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live join-message-group --app-id a494caec-000-695ef345db77 --group-id AE35-0000-T95F --user-id de100a0 --broad-cast-type 2 --broad-cast-statistics true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live JoinMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AppId 'a494caec-000-695ef345db77' --BroadCastType 2 --UserId de100a0 --BroadCastStatistics true --GroupId 'AE35-0000-T95F'
